title: Decarbonization and electricity price vulnerability
abstract:
Many countries in Europe have substantially increased their share of
carbon-free electricity over the past decades. However, the dramatic
2021-2022 increase in European natural gas prices and electricity prices
has raised concerns about the vulnerability of electricity markets. Here,
we develop a country-specific metric of vulnerability and find that
countries that pursued more aggressive electricity decarbonization are
not more vulnerable to natural gas price shocks. However, countries
with a higher share of intermittent renewable generation are slightly
more vulnerable, potentially due to the complementarity of these technologies
with natural gas generation. We show that heterogeneity in
vulnerability implies country-specific policies are required to avoid unintended
climate consequences of extreme electricity prices, in contrast
to the existing uniform EU price cap. Our results emphasize that
decarbonization goals can still be achieved without risking vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 过去几十年间，欧洲许多国家大幅提高了无碳电力的占比。然而，2021至2022年间欧洲天然气价格和电价的急剧上涨，引发了人们对电力市场脆弱性的担忧。在此，我们构建了一个针对各国的脆弱性指标，发现那些更为积极推进电力脱碳的国家，并不更容易受到天然气价格冲击的影响。然而，间歇性可再生能源发电占比较高的国家则略微更为脆弱，这可能是由于这些技术与天然气发电之间存在互补性。我们表明，脆弱性的异质性意味着需要因国而异的政策，以避免极端电价带来意想不到的气候后果，这与现行统一的欧盟电价上限形成对比。我们的结果表明，脱碳目标无需以脆弱性为代价即可实现。

title: Estimating the Costs and Benefits of Fuel-Economy Standards
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Fuel-economy standards for new vehicles are a primary policy instrument in many countries to reduce the carbon footprint of the transportation sector. These standards have many channels of costs and benefit, impacting sales, composition, vehicle attributes, miles traveled and externalities in the new-car fleet, as well as the composition and size of the used fleet. We develop a tractable analytical framework to examine the welfare effects of fuel-economy standards, and apply it to the recent government proposal to roll back fuel-economy standards. We find that our combined, multi-market vehicle choice model implies that the proposal would increase the size of the vehicle fleet over time, and also generates smaller welfare gains than models with a less rich structure of the vehicle market, such as the one used in the analysis associated with the 2018 Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) announcement. The disparities across the two models appear to result from the absence of feedback effects in the NPRM analysis. We stress the importance of instead using a multi-market vehicle choice model to provide the most accurate predictions of costs and benefits. We also derive bounds that can serve as a check on the theoretical consistency of such analyses, and that offer insights into the magnitudes of potential errors resulting from imperfect multi-market integration.
abstract_zh: 新车燃油经济性标准是许多国家降低交通运输部门碳足迹的主要政策工具。这些标准通过多种渠道产生成本和收益，影响销量、车型结构、车辆属性、行驶里程以及新车队的外部性，并影响二手车队的构成与规模。我们构建了一个易于处理的解析框架，考察燃油经济性标准的福利效应，并将其应用于政府近期提出的放松燃油经济性标准的方案。我们发现，我们结合多个市场的车辆选择模型表明，该方案将随时间推移扩大车队规模，而且所带来的福利收益也小于那些车辆市场结构较简单的模型，例如2018年《拟议规则制定通知》（NPRM）所采用的模型。两种模型之间的差异似乎源于NPRM分析中缺乏反馈效应。我们强调，应当改用多市场车辆选择模型，以对成本和收益作出最为准确的预测。我们还推导了一些界限，可用于检验此类分析的理论一致性，并揭示由多市场整合不完善所可能导致的误差大小。

Equity Implications of the COP21 Intended Nationally Determined Contributions to Reduce Greenhouse Gas Emissions
abstract: This chapter examines the equity implications of the “bottom-up” approach to climate change negotiations by analyzing the individual country unconditional greenhouse gas reduction pledges specified in the COP21 Agreement of 2015. It compares the implications before and after emissions trading in terms of the standard equity metrics of the Gini coefficient and Atkinson index for three major countries/regions: the European Union, China, and California. The chapter adapts a nonlinear programming model well suited to this purpose that determines the equilibrium emissions allowance price, mitigation costs, and allowance purchases and sales from trading. It also tests the sensitivity of the results to macroeconomic conditions and technological change. The findings are that the pledges made at COP21 reflect substantial inequality in general and run counter to most equity principles. They are definitely a major departure from the Egalitarian, Vertical, and Rawlsian equity principles proposed for many years by developing countries.
abstract_zh: 本章通过分析《2015年巴黎协定》（COP21）中各国无条件温室气体减排承诺，考察了气候变化谈判中“自下而上”方式的公平性影响。本章以基尼系数和阿特金森指数这两项标准的公平性指标，比较了欧盟、中国和加利福尼亚三个主要国家/地区在排放权交易前后的情况。本章采用了一个非线性规划模型，该模型适用于此目的，可确定均衡排放配额价格、减排成本，以及交易中的配额购买与出售。本章还检验了结果对宏观经济条件和技术变革的敏感性。研究发现，COP21上做出的承诺反映出普遍存在的严重不平等，并且与大多数公平原则相悖。这些承诺明显偏离了发展中国家多年来所提出的平等主义、纵向公平和罗尔斯式公平原则。

title: Vehicle Lifetime Trends and Scrappage Behavior in the U.S. Used Car Market
abstract: Using the most comprehensive publicly available data, we examine long-run changes in scrappage patterns in passenger cars and light trucks in the United States between 1969 and 1999. We find that the expected lifetime for passenger cars has increased from 12.5 to 14 years between 1969 and 1999. Our central estimate of the elasticity of scrappage with respect to vehicle prices is -0.83, which is substantially lower than reported in prior studies. These results imply that many public policies aimed at reducing gasoline consumption, including corporate average fuel economy standards and gasoline taxes, may be less effective than prior studies suggest. We also note that consumer scrappage behavior seems to respond more strongly to changes in vehicle price than to changes in gasoline price than standard theory would predict.
abstract_zh: 利用美国最全面的公开数据，我们考察了1969至1999年间美国乘用车和轻型卡车报废模式的长期变化。我们发现，1969年至1999年间，乘用车的预期使用寿命从12.5年增加到了14年。我们对报废量相对于车辆价格的弹性的中心估计值为-0.83，这大大低于以往研究的报告值。这些结果意味着，许多旨在减少汽油消费的公共政策（包括企业平均燃油经济性标准和汽油税）的效果可能不如以往研究所暗示的那样显著。我们还注意到，相较于标准理论的预测，消费者的报废行为对车辆价格变化的反应似乎比对汽油价格变化的反应更为强烈。

title: The Effects of Regulation in Multi-Output Firms: Safety Impacts from CAFE Standards
On the Importance of Baseline Setting in Markets for Carbon Offsets
abstract: Incorporating carbon offsets in the design of cap-and-trade programs remains a controversial issue because of its potential unintended impacts on emissions. At the heart of this discussion is the issue of crediting of emissions reductions. Projects can be correctly, over- or under-credited for their actual emissions reductions. We develop a unified framework that considers the supply of offsets within a cap-and-trade program that allows us to compare the relative impact of over-credited offsets and under-credited emissions reductions on overall emissions under different levels of baseline stringency and carbon prices. In the context of a national carbon pricing scheme that includes offsets, we find that the emissions impacts of over-credited offsets can be fully balanced out by under-credited emissions reductions without sacrificing a significant portion of the overall supply of offsets, provided emissions baselines are stringent enough. In the presence of high predicted business-as-usual (BAU) emissions uncertainty or low carbon prices, to maintain the environmental integrity of the program, baselines need to be set at stringent levels, in some cases below 50 percent of predicted BAU emissions. As predicted BAU emissions uncertainty declines or as the carbon market achieves higher equilibrium prices, however, less stringent baselines can balance out the emissions impacts of over-credited offsets and under-credited emissions reductions. These results imply that to maintain environmental integrity of offsets programs, baseline stringency should be tailored to project characteristics and market conditions that influence the proportion of over-credited offsets to under-credited emissions reductions.
abstract_zh: 在总量控制与交易计划的设计中纳入碳抵消，仍是一个有争议的问题，因为它可能对排放产生意想不到的影响。这一讨论的核心在于减排量的认定。项目的实际减排量可能被正确认定，也可能被高估或低估。我们构建了一个统一的框架，考虑了总量控制与交易计划中碳抵消的供给，使我们能够在不同的基准严格程度和碳价水平下，比较高估的碳抵消与低估的减排量对总体排放的相对影响。在一个包含碳抵消的全国碳定价方案背景下，我们发现，只要排放基准足够严格，高估的碳抵消所产生的排放影响可以被低估的减排量完全抵消，而无需牺牲碳抵消总供给的很大一部分。在存在高度的预测“一切照旧”（BAU）排放不确定性或碳价较低的情况下，为维持项目的环境完整性，基准需要设定在较为严格的水平，在某些情况下甚至低于预测BAU排放的50%。然而，随着预测BAU排放不确定性的下降，或碳市场达到更高的均衡价格，较不严格的基准即可平衡高估的碳抵消与低估的减排量所产生的排放影响。这些结果表明，为维持碳抵消计划的环境完整性，基准的严格程度应当根据项目特征以及影响高估的碳抵消与低估的减排量之比例的市场条件进行量身定制。

title: The Effects of Moral Licensing and Moral Cleansing in Contingent Valuation and Laboratory Experiments on the Demand to Reduce Externalities
Are there Carbon Savings from US Biofuel Policies? The Critical Importance of Accounting for Leakage in Land and Fuel Markets
abstract: We develop a multi-market model that integrates land, fuel, and food markets, and link it with an emissions model to quantify the importance of carbon leakage relative to the intended emissions savings resulting from the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) for conventional biofuels. We find that the RFS unambiguously increases emissions, with leakage from land and fuel markets offsetting 70.9% and 62.3% the intended emissions savings, respectively. Even when the Volumetric Ethanol Excise Tax Credit is phased out, the RFS provides at best modest emissions reductions.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个整合土地、燃料和粮食市场的多市场模型，并将其与排放模型相连接，以量化碳泄漏相对于《可再生燃料标准》（RFS）对传统生物燃料所预期的减排效果的重要性。我们发现，RFS无可争议地增加了排放，土地市场和燃料市场中的泄漏分别抵消了预期减排量的70.9%和62.3%。即使在逐步取消乙醇体积消费税抵免的情况下，RFS最多也只能带来适度的减排。

title: Designing Markets for Carbon Offsets with Distributional Constraints
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract:
This paper presents an assessment of the relative efficacy of three key instruments; baselines, trade ratios, and limits; which are under policy discussion in the design of carbon offset programs. Efficiency and distributional considerations are both present in choosing between them. We analyze the implication of the three instruments for the level of offsets and their composition (additional versus non-additional). We rank the instruments by their implications for total emissions, economic efficiency, and efficiency gain relative to a distributional transfer from capped to uncapped sectors. The analysis is conducted first in terms of a simple model of adverse selection in offset supply, and then calibrated numerically for the United States. Our major findings are as follows.
First, the baseline and trade ratio can be coupled together to yield a higher welfare gain, relative to settings where the instruments are individually selected. In this case, it is optimal for the policy maker to select a trade ratio less than one to encourage the supply of additional offsets. Second, when the trade ratio is restricted to not fall below one, the baseline is the best instrument for maximizing welfare. Adjusting the baseline attacks the problem of non-additionality directly, while the other two instruments can only approach the issue indirectly. Third, efficiency gain per unit of redistribution from the capped sector is also highest for the baseline instrument. The numerical value of this ratio, however, is below standard estimates for the marginal excess burden of public funds, which shows that offsets are worthwhile overall only if the capped sector is not compensated fully for its loss of rents. Fourth, when the baseline instrument is not fully reliable, as in the case of international offsets, then the other two instruments come into their own. In this case we show that the trade ratio instrument is superior to the limit instrument.
abstract_zh:
本文评估了碳抵消计划设计中正在讨论的三种关键政策工具的相对效力：基准、交易比率和上限。在这些工具之间进行选择时，效率与分配两方面的考量都会起作用。我们分析了这三种工具对碳抵消总量及其构成（附加性与非附加性）的影响。我们依据它们对总排放、经济效率以及相对于从受限部门向非受限部门进行分配性转移所带来的效率增益的影响，对这些工具进行排序。分析首先基于一个关于碳抵消供给中逆向选择的简单模型进行，随后针对美国进行了数值校准。我们的主要发现如下。
第一，基准与交易比率可以结合使用，相较于单独选择各工具的情形，能带来更高的福利增益。在这种情况下，政策制定者最优的选择是交易比率小于1，以鼓励附加性碳抵消的供给。第二，当交易比率被限制为不低于1时，基准是使福利最大化的最佳工具。调整基准直接解决了非附加性问题，而其他两种工具只能间接应对这一问题。第三，相对于受限部门的每单位再分配，所产生的效率增益在基准工具下同样最高。然而，该比率的数值低于公共资金边际超额负担的标准估计值，这表明只有在受限部门未被完全补偿其租金损失的情况下，碳抵消总体上才是值得的。第四，当基准工具不完全可靠时，例如在国际碳抵消中，其他两种工具便会发挥作用。在这种情况下，我们证明交易比率工具优于上限工具。

title: Optimal Price Instruments in Voluntary Emissions Markets
Who Benefits from Environmental Regulation? Evidence from the Clean Air Act Amendments
abstract: Using geographically disaggregated data and exploiting an instrumental variable strategy, we show that contrary to conventional wisdom, the benefits of the 1990 Clean Air Act Amendments (CAAA) were progressive. The CAAA created incentives for local regulators to target the initially dirtiest areas for cleanup, creating heterogeneity in the incidence of air quality improvements that favored lower-income households. Based on house price appreciation, households in the lowest quintile of the income distribution received annual benefits from the program equal to 0.3% of their income on average during the 1990s, over twice as much as those in the highest quintile.
abstract_zh: 利用地理上细分的数据，并采用工具变量策略，我们表明，与普遍看法相反，1990年《清洁空气法》修正案（CAAA）的收益具有累进性。CAAA激励地方监管机构优先治理最初污染最严重的地区，从而造成了空气质量改善在分布上的异质性，这种异质性有利于低收入家庭。基于房价升值的估计，收入分布最低五分位的家庭在20世纪90年代从该项目中获得的年均收益，平均相当于其收入的0.3%，是收入分布最高五分位家庭的两倍多。

title: Climate Policy Decisions Require Policy-Based Lifecycle Analysis
abstract: Lifecycle analysis (LCA) metrics of greenhouse gas emissions are increasingly being used to select technologies supported by climate policy. However, LCAs typically evaluate the emissions associated with a technology or product, not the impacts of policies. Here, we show that policies supporting the same technology can lead to dramatically different emissions impacts per unit of technology added, due to multimarket responses to the policy. Using a policy-based consequential LCA, we find that the lifecycle emissions impacts of four US biofuel policies range from a reduction of 16.1 gCO2e to an increase of 24.0 gCO2e per MJ corn ethanol added by the policy. The differences between these results and representative technology-based LCA measures, which do not account for the policy instrument driving the expansion in the technology, illustrate the need for policy-based LCA measures when informing policy decision making.
abstract_zh: 温室气体排放的生命周期分析（LCA）指标正日益被用于筛选受气候政策支持的技术。然而，LCA通常评估的是某项技术或产品的排放，而非政策的影响。在此，我们表明，支持同一技术的不同政策，由于政策引发的多市场响应，每新增单位技术所产生的排放影响可能存在巨大差异。利用基于政策的结果性（consequential）生命周期分析，我们发现美国四项生物燃料政策的全生命周期排放影响，每兆焦由政策新增的玉米乙醇，其排放变化范围从减少16.1克二氧化碳当量到增加24.0克二氧化碳当量。这些结果与具有代表性的基于技术的LCA指标之间存在差异，后者未考虑推动技术扩张的政策工具。这说明，在为政策决策提供依据时，需要基于政策的LCA指标。

title: The Unintended Consequences of Regulation in the Presence of Multiple Unpriced Externalities: Evidence from the Transportation Sector
Carpooling and Driver Responses to Fuel Price Changes: Evidence from Traffic Flows in Los Angeles
Equity Impacts of Environmental Policy
abstract: This article surveys recent literature on the equity impacts of environmental policy. We focus on studies that look at the distribution of costs and benefits of alternative environmental policies. We also examine potentially important trade-offs between efficiency and equity that arise in the context of environmental policy, as well as transition effects. In many of the applications surveyed here, environmental policies can be regressive. Strategies are discussed to reduce this regressivity through the use of revenues from certain policy instruments. With regard to the distribution of the benefits of environmental policy, we conclude that there is a need for more spatially disaggregated studies that simultaneously capture the spatial and socioeconomic impacts of environmental policy.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了近期关于环境政策公平性影响的文献。我们重点关注那些考察不同环境政策成本与收益分配的研究。我们还探讨了环境政策背景下可能出现的效率与公平之间的重要权衡，以及过渡效应。在本文综述的许多应用中，环境政策可能具有累退性。文中讨论了利用某些政策工具的收入来减轻这种累退性的策略。关于环境政策收益的分配，我们得出结论：需要更多在空间上细分的研究，以同时捕捉环境政策的空间影响和社会经济影响。

Efficiency and Distributional Impacts of Increased U.S. Gasoline Taxes
abstract: We examine the impacts of increased US gasoline taxes in a model that links the markets for new, used, and scrapped vehicles and recognizes the considerable heterogeneity among households and cars. Household choice parameters derive from an estimation procedure that integrates individual choices for car ownership and miles traveled. We find that each cent-per-gallon increase in the price of gasoline reduces the equilibrium gasoline consumption by about 0.2 percent. Taking account of revenue recycling, the impact of a 25-cent gasoline tax increase on the average household is about $30 per year (2001 dollars). Distributional impacts depend importantly on how additional revenues from the tax increase are recycled. (JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71)
abstract_zh: 我们在一个模型中考察了美国提高汽油税的影响，该模型连接了新车、二手车和报废车辆的市场，并考虑了家庭和汽车之间的显著异质性。家庭的选择参数来源于一个整合了个体车辆持有与行驶里程选择的估计程序。我们发现，汽油价格每提高一美分/加仑，均衡汽油消费量约减少0.2%。考虑收入回收后，汽油税每提高25美分/加仑，对普通家庭的影响约为每年30美元（2001年美元）。分配效应在很大程度上取决于税收增加所带来的额外收入如何被回收利用。（JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71）

title: The Effects of Moratorium on Residential Development: Evidence from a Matching Approach
The Impact of Policies to Control Motor Vehicle Emissions in Mumbai, India
abstract: This paper examines the impact of measures to reduce emissions from passenger transport, specifically buses, cars, and two-wheelers in Mumbai. These include converting diesel buses to compressed natural gas (CNG), as the Indian Supreme Court required in Delhi, which would necessitate an increase in bus fares to cover the cost of pollution controls. The authors model an increase in the price of gasoline, which should affect the ownership and use of cars and two-wheelers, as well as imposing a license fee on cars to retard growth in car ownership. The impact of each policy on emissions depends not only on how the policy affects the mode that is regulated, but on shifts to other modes. The results suggest that the most effective policy to reduce emissions from passenger vehicles-in terms of the total number of tons of PM10 (particulate matter that measure less than or equal to 10 micrometers in aerodynamic diameter) reduced-is to convert diesel buses to CNG. The conversion of 3,391 diesel buses to CNG would result in an emissions reduction of 663 tons of PM10 a year, 14 percent of total emissions from transport. The bus conversion program passes the cost-benefit test. In contrast, the results suggest the elasticities of emissions from transport with respect to a gasoline tax and a tax on vehicle ownership are -0.04 and -0.10 respectively. As a consequence, it would take substantial increases in the gasoline tax or vehicle ownership tax to produce reductions in emissions similar to the bus conversion program. These results, however, reflect the low shares of cars and two-wheelers in the Mumbai emissions inventory and need not apply to cities, such as Delhi, where these shares are higher
abstract_zh: 本文考察了减少孟买客运交通排放措施的影响，具体涉及公共汽车、小汽车和两轮车。这些措施包括：按照印度最高法院在德里的要求，将柴油公交车改为压缩天然气（CNG）公交车，这将需要提高公交车票价以覆盖污染控制成本；作者还模拟了汽油价格上涨的影响，这将影响小汽车和两轮车的拥有与使用；以及对小汽车征收牌照费，以抑制小汽车拥有量的增长。每项政策对排放的影响，不仅取决于其对受规制交通方式的作用，也取决于出行向其他方式的转移。结果表明，就减少的PM10（空气动力学直径小于或等于10微米的颗粒物）吨数而言，减少客运车辆排放的最有效政策是将柴油公交车改为CNG公交车。将3,391辆柴油公交车改为CNG后，每年可减少663吨PM10排放，相当于交通总排放量的14%。公交车改造项目通过了成本收益检验。相比之下，结果显示交通排放对汽油税和车辆拥有税的弹性分别为-0.04和-0.10。因此，若要实现与公交车改造项目相近的减排效果，需要大幅提高汽油税或车辆拥有税。然而，这些结果反映了小汽车和两轮车在孟买排放清单中的占比较低，未必适用于此类占比更高的城市，例如德里

Estimating the Welfare effect of Congestion Taxes: The Critical Importance of other Distortions within the Transportation System
Revenue-Recycling and the Welfare Effects of Road Pricing
abstract: This paper explores the interactions between taxes on work-related traffic congestion and pre-existing distortionary taxes in the labor market.A congestion tax raises the overall costs of commuting to work and discourages labor force participation at the margin, when revenues are returned in lump-sum transfers. We find that the resulting efficiency loss in the labor market can be larger than the Pigouvian efficiency gains from internalizing the congestion externality. In contrast, if congestion tax revenues are used to reduce labor taxes the net impact on labor supply is positive, and the efficiency gain in the labor market can raise the overall welfare gains of the congestion tax by as much as 100 percent. Recycling congestion tax revenues in public transit subsidies produces a positive, but smaller, impact on labor supply. In short, our results indicate that the presence of pre-existing tax distortions, and the form of revenue recycling, can crucially affect the magnitude, and possibly even the sign, of the welfare effect of road-pricing schemes. The efficiency gains from recycling congestion tax revenues in other tax reductions can amount to several times the Pigouvian welfare gains from congestion reduction.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了与工作相关的交通拥堵税与既有扭曲性税收在劳动力市场中的相互作用。当收入以一次性转移支付的方式返还时，拥堵税会提高通勤至工作地点的总成本，并在边际上抑制劳动参与。我们发现，由此产生的劳动力市场效率损失可能大于内部化拥堵外部性所带来的庇古式效率收益。相反，如果拥堵税收入用于降低劳动税，则对劳动供给的净影响为正，劳动力市场中的效率收益可使拥堵税的总福利增益提高多达100%。将拥堵税收入用于公共交通补贴，对劳动供给的影响为正，但较小。简言之，我们的结果表明，既有税收扭曲的存在以及收入回收的形式，会对道路定价方案福利效应的大小，甚至符号，产生关键影响。将拥堵税收入用于其他税收减免所带来的效率收益，可能达到减少拥堵所产生的庇古福利收益的数倍。

title: Tax Deductions, Environmental Policy, and the 'Double Dividend' Hypothesis

abstract: No AccessPolicy Research Working Papers21 Jun 2013Tax Deductions, Environmental Policy, and the Double Dividend HypothesisAuthors/Editors: Antonio Bento and Ian ParryAntonio Bento and Ian Parryhttps://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-2119SectionsAboutPDF (0.2 MB) ToolsAdd to favoritesDownload CitationsTrack Citations ShareFacebookTwitterLinked In Abstract:May 1999 Recent studies find that environmental tax swaps typically exacerbate the costs of the tax system and therefore do not produce a double dividend. This paper extends previous models by incorporating tax-favored consumption goods. In this setting, the efficiency gains from recycling environmental tax revenues are larger because preexisting taxes distort the consumption bundle, in addition to factor markets. A genuine double dividend is then found. Parry and Bento find that incorporating tax-favored consumption in models of environmental tax swaps may overturn key results from earlier studies. In particular, a revenue-neutral pollution tax (or auctioned permits) can produce a substantial double dividend by reducing both pollution and the costs of the tax system. The second dividend arises because the welfare gain from using environmental tax revenues to cut labor taxes is much larger when labor taxes also distort the choice among consumption goods. Indeed (ignoring environmental benefits), the overall costs of a revenue-neutral pollution tax are negative in the benchmark simulations, at least for pollution reductions up to 17 percent, and possibly up to 42 percent. In addition, Parry and Bento show that the presence of tax-favored consumption may drastically increase the efficiency gain from using (revenue-neutral) emissions taxes (or auctioned emissions permits) rather than grandfathered emissions permits. This paper-a product of Infrastructure and Environment, Development Research Group-is part of a larger effort in the group to study regulatory policies in a second-best setting. abstract_zh: 无访问权限 政策研究工作论文 2013年6月21日 税收减免、环境政策与双重红利假说 作者/编者：Antonio Bento 与 Ian Parry Antonio Bento 与 Ian Parry https://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-2119 栏目 关于 PDF（0.2 MB） 工具 添加到收藏夹 下载引文 追踪引文 分享 Facebook Twitter LinkedIn 摘要： 1999年5月 近期研究发现，环境税收替代通常会加重税制成本，因此并不会产生双重红利。本文在以往模型的基础上，纳入了享受税收优惠的消费品。在这一设定下，由于既有税收不仅扭曲要素市场，也扭曲消费组合，回收环境税收入的效率收益更大，从而产生了真正的双重红利。Parry与Bento发现，在环境税替代模型中纳入享受税收优惠的消费，可能会推翻早期研究的关键结论。特别是，收入中性的污染税（或拍卖排放许可）可以通过同时减少污染和税制成本而产生可观的双重红利。第二重红利源于：当劳动税也扭曲消费品之间的选择时，用环境税收入削减劳动税所带来的福利增益要大得多。实际上（暂不考虑环境效益），在基准模拟中，收入中性污染税的总成本为负，至少在污染减少幅度达17%时如此，可能甚至在减少幅度达42%时仍然如此。此外，Parry与Bento表明，享受税收优惠的消费的存在，可能大幅提高使用（收入中性的）排放税（或拍卖排放许可）相对于无偿分配排放许可所带来的效率增益。本文是世界银行基础设施与环境发展研究小组（Infrastructure and Environment, Development Research Group）的研究成果，属于该小组在次优环境下研究监管政策的更大工作的一部分。作者的联系方式为 [email protected] 或 [email protected]。上一本书 下一本书 图表 参考文献 推荐 详细信息 被引用 《公平企业税收背景下的税收政策》（2021年7月15日） 出版： 1999年5月 版权与许可 相关国家：东帝汶 相关主题：环境、宏观经济学与经济增长 关键词：消费、双重红利、效率、排放、排放税、环境、环境政策、环境税、环境保护、环境税、市场、模型、自然资源、政策制定者、回收、资源、收入、税收 下载PDF 加载中...
